shortDescription: Manages ARP attributes of VXLAN on HUAWEI CloudEngine devices.

options.name: arp_collect_host
options.description: Enables EVN BGP or BGP EVPN to collect host information.

options.name: arp_suppress
options.description: Enables ARP broadcast suppression in a BD.

options.name: bridge_domain_id
options.description: Specifies a BD(bridge domain) ID. The value is an integer ranging from 1 to 16777215.

options.name: evn_peer_ip
options.description: Specifies the IP address of an EVN BGP peer. The value is in dotted decimal notation.

options.name: evn_reflect_client
options.description: Configures the local device as the route reflector (RR) and its peer as the client.

options.name: evn_server
options.description: Configures the local device as the router reflector (RR) on the EVN network.

options.name: evn_source_ip
options.description: Specifies the source address of an EVN BGP peer. The value is in dotted decimal notation.

options.name: host_collect_protocol
options.description: Enables EVN BGP or BGP EVPN to advertise host information.

options.name: state
options.description: Determines whether the config should be present or not on the device.

options.name: vbdif_name
options.description: Full name of VBDIF interface, i.e. Vbdif100.
